claim: The authenticated starred listing held 357 repositories: the 342 identities of the 2026-09-20 public snapshot plus 15 additions, with no removals, duplicates or private repositories.
endpoint: GET /user/starred, authenticated, Accept: application/vnd.github.star+json, all pages
identity_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(sorted(full_name.lower() for row in rows), separators=(',', ':')); the same 357 strings are the owner/name paths of catalogs/us-equities/coverage.json stars[], lowercased.

visibility_check.method: One GitHub GraphQL query of repository(owner, name) { isPrivate isArchived viewerHasStarred databaseId } for the 15 additions.

limitations: Identity refresh only. Repository content, licenses and maintenance are covered by the per-entry reviews in star-audit.json, not by this listing.

The listing was captured by the coordinating session; its retained projection has no numeric ids, so duplicates were checked by lowercase full_name, and the ids above come from the separate GraphQL check.
The exact invocation and raw responses are not retained. checked_at_utc is the write time of the snapshot file; the fetch completed shortly before it.
Per-repository starred_at values from the star+json response are not published (star-audit.json method.private_handling).
